newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Jan CPI down 0.5 pct on Nov'96 - CSO.
newsitem.headline: Irish Jan CPI down 0.5 pct on Nov'96 - CSO.

text.p: The Irish January Consumer price index was down 0.5 percent on November 1996 and up 0.9 percent of February 1996, the Central Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
This is the first monthly Irish consumer price data and will bring Ireland into line with the rest of the European Union.
Up until now, the CSO has released the CPI on a quarterly basis so there are no monthly comparable readings for 1996.
Market forecasts for the CPI had ranged from 0.1 to 0.3 percent and from 1.7 to 1.8 percent.
